about: Public SQLite WAL documentation, Overview item 8 (https://www.sqlite.org/wal.html, reviewed 2026-11-15). The gigabyte warning is struck through and explicitly superseded by the 3.11.0 correction. A current warning must fail; historical attribution and corrected behavior are supported controls. This arose from a real snippet-only run; this case supplies the missing full context to test interpretation separately from retrieval.

findings.title: Write-Ahead Logging - SQLite
findings.content: [Superseded text: WAL works best with smaller transactions. WAL does not work well for very large transactions. For transactions in excess of a gigabyte, WAL mode may fail with an I/O or disk-full error.] Beginning with version 3.11.0 (2016-02-15), WAL mode works as efficiently with large transactions as does rollback mode.

claims.claim: Current SQLite WAL guidance warns that transactions exceeding a gigabyte may fail and recommends rollback mode.
Beginning with version 3.11.0, WAL mode works as efficiently with large transactions as does rollback mode.
